entries.11787db6bdf7880a: This is a reportable segment that rents steel formwork used to manufacture wave-dissipating and foundation blocks for revetments at ports, fishing ports, airports, rivers and coastlines, and sells related products, experimental equipment and software. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,326 million. The company and Sanbashira Co., Ltd. rent steel formwork for wave-dissipating and foundation blocks, etc.
entries.1ca0bf01f6a87ec0: Sales of related products, experimental equipment and software, etc.
entries.1d98a24160f539eb: A construction company with three businesses — ground improvement, civil engineering and blocks — in which the ground improvement business accounts for more than half of revenue.
entries.4380c4c7af3a42be: It performs marine civil engineering works, including ports, reclaimed revetments and coastlines.
entries.5eb58ab05bcd0f7f: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, consisting of service businesses such as insurance agency services within the group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥160 million. Fukuku Shoji Co., Ltd. provides services such as insurance agency services, and the group companies receive these services.
entries.774ecb0127cc14bd: It rents steel formwork for manufacturing wave-dissipating and foundation blocks. Sanbashira Co., Ltd. also rents steel formwork, etc. to the company's civil engineering business division.
entries.85bbf66c3f584184: This is a reportable segment that performs land and marine ground improvement construction, rents construction machinery and sells related products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥44,414 million. The company, Soil Technica Co., Ltd., Fudo Construction Inc., Aichi Base Industry Co., Ltd., Japan Soil Test Center Co., Ltd., and Koyo Construction Industry Co., Ltd. and others perform ground improvement construction, etc.
entries.8d423d783256006d: Rental of construction machinery and sales of related products
entries.8f0a765079dfcb93: It sells products, experimental equipment and software, etc. related to blocks.
entries.a2b8f5d1a39a8477: It rents construction machinery used for ground improvement construction and sells related products. Soil Technica Co., Ltd. rents construction machinery from the company.
entries.a46792fd436aeb40: This is a reportable segment that performs land civil engineering works, including roads, tunnels, bridges and sewers, and marine civil engineering works, including ports, reclaimed revetments and coastlines. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥34,801 million. The company and Takahashi Akikazu Construction Co., Ltd. perform civil engineering works, and the two companies place orders for and receive orders for construction work from each other.
entries.a7c4ee2db1981219: It performs land and marine ground improvement construction. It uses methods such as the sand compaction pile method and solidification treatment methods, including sand pile-based and solidification-based methods.
entries.b442fdd0c1465e7b: It performs land civil engineering works, including roads, tunnels, bridges and sewers.
